pages.name: Round 8: final silk and blog card (pick)

Main.dc.html.title: Home, desktop (day; press the moon for night)

R3Why1.dc.html.title: Why, option W1: two-row deck with a peek (auto slides one column)

R3Why2.dc.html.title: Why, option W2: Dim Gray band, two rows gliding opposite ways; tap a card to read it

R3Why3.dc.html.title: Why, option W3: numbered index cards, story progress bar, tap opens the text below

R3Built1.dc.html.title: Built, option B1: image tiles in two rows (tap opens the text); images shown are stand-ins

R3Built2.dc.html.title: Built, option B2: editorial spec sheet, the guideline's black hairlines, two per page, auto pages

R3Built3.dc.html.title: Built, option B3: square tiles, 2 x 2 per page on a turquoise wash, tap opens the text

R3Care1.dc.html.title: Our Healthcare, option H1: bento, all seven at once, tap a tile for its page

R3Care2.dc.html.title: Our Healthcare, option H2: image accordion, all seven titles at once, one opens with its text

R3Care3.dc.html.title: Our Healthcare, option H3: one featured service rotates on its own (story bars); seven thumbnails jump to any

R3About1d.dc.html.title: About band, option A1 desktop: light editorial: white to turquoise wash, black Helma, the route with one gliding light (no pulsing)

R3About2d.dc.html.title: About band, option A2 desktop: image-led: the photo fills the card, the words sit on a frosted glass panel

R3About3d.dc.html.title: About band, option A3 desktop: deep and calm: Black to Dim Gray with a soft turquoise horizon, numbered route, framed photo

R3Upgrades.dc.html.title: Other phone upgrades: Mission & Vision tabs, journey line, maritime chips, impact tiles

HDD1.dc.html.title: Header D1 desktop: floating glass capsule: clear over the hero, a centred glass pill once you scroll

HDD2.dc.html.title: Header D2 desktop: full-width glass bar: tall and clear at the top, then a slim frosted bar with a hairline

HDD3.dc.html.title: Header D3 desktop: three islands: logo chip, centred glass nav pill, call to action; on scroll the islands tighten

HDM1.dc.html.title: Phone menu M1: full-screen white menu: big Helma links rise one by one, numbered; Talk to our team pinned at the bottom

HDM2.dc.html.title: Phone menu M2: bottom sheet in thumb reach: the page dims and blurs, a sheet slides up with a 2 x 4 grid of links, languages and the call

HDM3.dc.html.title: Phone menu M3: Dim Gray glass panel from the right: white Helma links, quick contact row (WhatsApp, call, email), the page slides a little left behind it

R4Tst1.dc.html.title: Testimonials T1 (your spec): portrait stories, arrows on the videos, Swipe for more; third video cropped to portrait; tap opens it full screen in its original shape

R4Tst2.dc.html.title: Testimonials T2: the centre story large, the others smaller and dimmed behind it, arrows on the videos, Swipe for more; tap opens full screen

R4Why1.dc.html.title: Why Y1: a numbered index on the guideline's hairlines; all seven titles at a glance, tap one to read it

R4Why2.dc.html.title: Why Y2: bento; the first reason as a dark lead card with its text, the six others in a clean 2 x 3 grid, tap any for its text

R4Why3.dc.html.title: Why Y3: a vertical spine with icons, title and a two-line reason each; reads straight down, nothing hidden behind taps

R4Who1.dc.html.title: Who W1: choose your path; six rows like a menu, tap one to see its line and go to its page (no sliding)

R4Who2.dc.html.title: Who W2: a stacked deck; swipe the top card away to reveal the next (the motion is shown looping)

R4Who3.dc.html.title: Who W3: a row of partner chips like tabs; tapping one swaps the dark panel under it

R4Built.dc.html.title: Built, minimal: the same two rows that slide on their own, icon tiles instead of photos (light turquoise and dark)

R5ModalWhy.dc.html.title: Modal, Why (desktop): a split card; the Dim Gray panel carries the number and a large hairline icon now, and becomes the image later; step through all seven inside

R5ModalWhyP.dc.html.title: Modal, Why (phone): a bottom sheet that slides up; drag it down or tap the X to close

R5ModalBuilt.dc.html.title: Modal, Built (desktop): image-led; the photo carries the title, the text sits under it; step through all six (the Built photos come back here)

R5ModalBuiltP.dc.html.title: Modal, Built (phone): a tall sheet with the photo on top; swipe sideways for the next one

R5ModalCare.dc.html.title: Modal, Our Healthcare (desktop): side by side, the photo full height; the text, a Read more to the service page, and the seven services as thumbnails

R5ModalCareP.dc.html.title: Modal, Our Healthcare (phone): a sheet with the photo on top, the text and Read more

R5BuiltBento.dc.html.title: Built on phones, option A, bento: a wide dark tile first and last, four light tiles between; the closing line on two lines under a hairline; tap a tile for its modal

R5BuiltGrid.dc.html.title: Built on phones, option B, 2 x 3: six equal tiles in a light and dark checker; the closing line on two lines, left aligned, small then large

R5RingClock.dc.html.title: How Our System Works on phones, option A, the clock: the twelve services as icons around the traveller; one lights up at a time and its name shows under the ring; tap any icon

R5RingLegend.dc.html.title: How Our System Works on phones, option B, clock and key: the same ring with numbered icons, and a two-column key of all twelve names under it

R5MarCover.dc.html.title: Maritime on phones, option A, cover story: your deck photo full bleed with the title on it, the two paragraphs, the services in a swipe row, two of your photos, the call

R5MarCollage.dc.html.title: Maritime on phones, option B, collage: three of your photos as a collage first, then the eyebrow, title and paragraphs, the five services as tiles (the last one dark), the call

R8Silk1.dc.html.title: Silk S1 desktop: hairline silk: seven fine lines crossing slowly, the Mission & Vision lines grown up; the calmest

R8Silk2.dc.html.title: Silk S2 desktop: satin ribbon: one folded band of turquoise fabric over a soft grey fold, a white sheen gliding along it; no threads

R8Silk3.dc.html.title: Silk S3 desktop: silk and threads: a pale satin band with five hairlines riding its edges, the centre one turquoise

R8Card1.dc.html.title: Blog card C1 desktop: portrait editorial: an open 4:5 photo with rounded corners (the newest posts are portrait, nothing is cut), the dateline and a Helma title under it, no box

R8Card1m.dc.html.title: Blog card C1 phone (slides on its own)

R8Card2.dc.html.title: Blog card C2 desktop: story cover: the 4:5 photo fills the card, the title sits on a soft dark fade at the bottom, the place as a glass chip on top

R8Card2m.dc.html.title: Blog card C2 phone (slides on its own)

R8Card3.dc.html.title: Blog card C3 desktop: news desk: the newest post as a tall 4:5 cover on the left, the next two as rows with a small portrait photo, the place and the title, divided by hairlines
